parsed.summary: The patch introduces a change to enforce consistent signs on eigenvectors, but it may not fully resolve the issue and could introduce behavioral regressions.

issues.description: The patch does not address the root cause of the sign differences, which could be due to numerical precision issues or other factors. This may not fully resolve the issue.
Enforcing consistent signs on eigenvectors could potentially break existing behavior or introduce unexpected results in other scenarios where sign differences are meaningful.
The patch does not include any additional tests to verify that the change does not introduce new issues or regressions.
